title: Scan a terminal QR on your phone to review and approve a new ReMCP computer.
changes: Display a compact QR in capable interactive terminals beside the existing single-use pairing code and browser URL. The phone opens the same signed-in /device confirmation page; approval remains explicit and is not a passwordless login.
Encode the QR locally with a pinned MIT library, require same-origin HTTPS and the matching code, and reject alternate hosts, redirects, modified parameters and insecure URLs.
Preserve the text URL/code fallback on narrow or noninteractive terminals and allow disabling QR with --no-qr.
Maintain the re-pairing safeguards introduced in 0.2.193; a previously paired computer does not request a new grant without explicit --re-pair.
Verify independent QR decodability, all CLI/auth/security regressions and a clean public package projection.
